During your move phase, when moving with a 'squad' of up to two other stormtroopers, they all move (using landspeed) for 1 Force.” '''What changed:''' Same words as [[Captain Mod Terrik]] (Original). The sheet reprints the PC card image of [[Captain Mod Terrik]] (published 18 June 2023) as a printable slip under the label “•Captain Mod Terrik”, pixel for pixel the same except that the picture area is left blank (white), so the slip can be laid over the picture of the card named in its lower-left corner ([[Imperial Squad Leader]]). A separate Players Committee publication, so its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: every publication is a version; a release-sheet slip and the PC card image are separate printings). The PDF was created on 17 June 2023, the day before the set's release (18 June 2023); the sheet was published with the set, so the slip is placed after the card image in place at release. '''Errata mark:''' the slip prints no errata mark, but it is errata 1 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026).
